messages:
Aisha: @here thinking of doing an indie speedrun watch + couch co-op relay this Friday in the mezzanine projector area. Who's in? :popcorn:
Sam: love this. what time? i can bring a power strip and some pizzas. :pizza:
Noah: 7pm works for me. can we also do a quick 15-min chill warmup with party games? keeps the skill gap funny. :laughing:
Priya: i can bring my capture card (Elgato HD60 S) if we want to stream a bit. need an HDMI adapter for my Switch dock though. anyone have USB-C->HDMI spare?
Connor: i have a spare USB-C -> HDMI adapter and an extra ethernet cable. also happy to lug a folding table for the projector setup.
Aisha: perfect. capture card could be great for a highlights reel. Priya, you cool if we post short clips to the social channel later?
Priya: yep fine by me as long as people opt out if they don't want their face on socials.
Sam: quick poll: pizza + soda or pizza + tacos? react with :one: for soda, :two: for tacos.
Noah: also, who wants to do a 2v2 Smash mini-tourny between sets? low effort bracket? :smash:
BuildBot: Room booking reminder: mezzanine projector reserved Fri 19:00-22:30. Please keep noise reasonable for neighboring offices.
Connor: awesome, thanks @BuildBot. i'll bring a multi-plug surge protector and an HDMI switch in case multiple consoles need to connect quickly.
Aisha: logistically: bring controllers, controllers chargers, and any platform-specific cables. i'll make a short checklist in this thread tomorrow.
Sam: shoutout to Priya for offering capture gear 🙌 and to Connor for the adapters. can we pin the checklist when it's up?
Priya: also FYI i have a spare Steam key for the indie game "Cave Custodians" — whoever wants to try speedruns can use it. first come first serve.
Noah: i'll take the key if it's free! been wanting to practice short routes.
Aisha: sold — this is shaping up to be a fun low-key night. see y'all Friday :partyparrot:
